name: Ambient Compressor
description: A slow hand on the fader: it rides swells over seconds, is not driven by sub rumble, and leaves a dying tail to die away.

params.name: Threshold
params.description: The level above which the gain starts to come down. Lower catches more of the sound; higher leaves all but the loudest swells alone.

params.name: Ratio
params.description: How firmly a swell over the threshold is held back. Low is gentle levelling; high pins loud passages close to the threshold.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long the gain takes to come down once a swell passes the threshold. Slow lets the start of a swell through before it is reined in.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long the gain takes to come back once the level falls. Short recovers between phrases; long holds the level steady across them.

params.name: Knee
params.description: How gradually compression sets in around the threshold. Wide eases in well below it; zero is a hard corner at the threshold.

params.name: Tails
params.description: Hold pauses the release while a sound dies away, so a tail keeps its own shape. Release is the classic way, which pulls a tail back up.

params.name: Ignore below
params.description: Keeps lows under this frequency out of the level detector, so sub rumble does not drive the compressor. The lows stay in the sound.

params.name: Make-up
params.description: Gain added after compression to bring the level back up. It applies to the compressed signal only, not to the dry part of Mix.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the compressed one. Settings in between give parallel compression, with the dry dynamics on top.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. A stereo-linked feed-forward RMS compressor whose times are counted in seconds, with a high-passed sidechain and a release that waits while a tail dies away; not a model of any unit.
